label: VERIFIED
extraction: Orchestrator Pipeline (shared engine for orch-* skills): classifies request size (trivial/small/standard/large) based on files touched, new dependencies, design ambiguity - highest tier determines phases. Five operation skills: orch-add-feature (new capability), orch-change-feature (tweak working behavior), orch-fix-defect (reproduce as failing test then fix), orch-refine-code (behavior-preserving refactor), orch-build-mvp (bootstrap from design doc). Phases: 0 Intake (restate/read spec), 1 Research & Reuse (gh search, Context7, vendor docs, package registries, Exa - prefer proven implementations), 2 Plan (delegate to planner/architect agent, output task_list as thin vertical slices) -> GATE 1, 3 Scaffold (orch-build-mvp only: stand up first end-to-end slice), 4 Implement TDD (tdd-guide agent: red-green-refactor per task) -> GATE 2, 5 Review (code-reviewer + security-reviewer on security triggers), 6 Commit (conventional commits, one per logical chunk). Two gates: Gate 1 after Plan (present task_list, no implementation until user approves), Gate 2 before Commit (present diff summary + proposed messages, no commit until user confirms). Security triggers: auth/authz, user input, DB queries, filesystem paths, external API calls, crypto, secrets.
